Technical Marketing Manager


Team: Siemens, Data Centers & AI Factories, Marketing & Communications
Location: U.S. Remote (access to a major U.S. airport)


Transform the everyday with us! At Siemens, we combine the real and digital worlds to enable sustainable progress. Our global, diverse team puts people first, supporting and challenging you to grow in new ways.


Role Overview

The Technical Marketing Manager bridges technical development and commercial go-to-market strategy for our Data Centers & AI Factories vertical. By combining deep technical fluency with strategic storytelling, you will translate complex technologies such as power systems, cooling, automation, and digital twins into credible, value-driven narratives and assets that empower sales teams, partners, and customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Content Creation & Storytelling: Architect and produce high-impact technical assets including white papers, solution briefs, reference architectures, technical presentations, and demos that articulate Siemens’ business and technical value.
  • Sales & Partner Enablement: Build sales tools (talk tracks, FAQs, competitive guides, discovery questions) and co-deliver training programs, workshops, and launch materials to prepare sellers and ecosystem partners.
  • Technical Validation: Collaborate with SMEs, engineers, and solution architects to validate technical claims, benchmarks, simulations, and proofs of value for accuracy and credibility.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the bridge between technical teams, product management, sales, marketing, and partners to ensure consistent, appropriate audience messaging.
  • Optimization & Innovation: Leverage feedback, performance data analytics, and emerging approaches (including generative AI and interactive media) to continuously improve content quality and relevance.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:


Basic Qualifications


  • Experience: 8+ years in technical marketing, solutions marketing, product marketing, technical communications, solutions architecture, or engineering within B2B technology.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Center Infrastructure, Technical Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Content & Communication: Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into accurate, compelling narratives across multiple formats (white papers, visual-story telling, presentations, reference architectures).
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience partnering with engineering, product, sales, and executive stakeholders to drive alignment and validate technical claims.
  • Enablement & Readiness: Demonstrated track record of creating and delivering training, sales tools, or readiness programs that equip teams to position complex solutions.
  • Autonomy: A self-starter with strong project management skills, capable of managing multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, matrixed global organization.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Domain Depth: Familiarity with the full data center lifecycle (design, construction, operation, optimization) and target segments (hyperscalers, neo-cloud, colocation, enterprise, EPCs).
  • AI & Modern Tools: Experience leveraging generative AI/LLMs responsibly for content scaling, alongside familiarity with modern content management and sales enablement platforms.
  • Portfolio: A portfolio of technical writing, solution content, demonstrations, or enablement materials showcasing your ability to communicate complex technologies effectively.

About Siemens:


We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.


Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:


We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

data.description_html:
Reports to: Eric Siu, CEO
Type: Full-time, client-facing player-coach. Not a people-manager seat.
Clients: an assigned book of Single Grain SEO/AEO accounts
Location: Full-time, remote, with at least 4 hours of US time-zone overlap
Comp: $100,000–$150,000 USD / year

One-liner

Get Single Grain clients cited in AI answers and growing qualified organic pipeline, with agents doing most of the production.

About the role

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. Search is splitting between Google and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and buyers now build their shortlist before they click. This seat owns SEO and AEO for an assigned set of client accounts: what to ship, why, and how we will know it worked.

You are the client's organic strategist and you stay hands-on. You set the roadmap, you build the agents that do the production, and you report citations and pipeline, not ranking screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. You will work inside Single Brain (our agent operating layer) and ClickFlow (our AI content-optimization platform), and build your own workflows in tools like Claude Code. Use AI for research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, and reporting, and check what it produces before anything ships.

What you will own

  • Diagnose each client's search demand, answer-engine visibility, technical health, content system, and conversion path; set baselines and targets.

  • Own the SEO/AEO roadmap for your accounts and decide what ships next.

  • Track answer-engine citations: a fixed prompt set per client, run weekly across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, logging where the client and its competitors are cited.

  • Build and maintain the agents that do production (research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, reporting) and get teammates using them.

  • Keep brief-to-publish under five working days, with a human check on facts, brand, and technical accuracy.

  • Lead client strategy calls with proactive recommendations; give writers, developers, and analysts clear acceptance criteria.

  • Report monthly in terms a GM would use: citations, qualified organic traffic, and pipeline or revenue where attribution allows.

  • Write runbooks so the system runs without you at the keyboard.

What success looks like

  • By day 30: client diagnoses done; baselines set for citations and qualified organic pipeline; your AI citation tracker is live and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.

  • By day 60: an agent-built brief-to-publish pipeline is running on every account; the monthly citation + pipeline report is in use with clients.

  • By day 90: brief-to-publish under five working days; at least one account up on answer-engine citations or qualified organic pipeline vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = content volume going up with no citation or pipeline readback.

  • By 6–12 months: citations and qualified organic pipeline up across your book; workflows do 70%+ of production; clients treat you as their go-to marketing strategist; you have designed yourself out of the daily queue.

Evidence we want to see

  • 6+ years in SEO or organic growth, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, with client-facing ownership.

  • Shipped answer-engine or AI-for-SEO work we can inspect: the pages, the citations, and how you measured them.

  • One agent or workflow you built and still maintain that removed real production work: inputs, outputs, QA, and the result.

  • One quantified result (citations, qualified traffic, pipeline, or revenue) with the baseline, period, and how you attributed it.

  • AI fluency you can show: how answer engines retrieve and cite sources, and which calls you still make yourself.

  • Strong technical SEO, analytics, and prioritization judgment.

  • Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).

  • Ideal: specialist search agency or an in-house growth team that ships; B2B.

What this role is not

Not a content-volume role. Not vendor management or QC-only. Not a strategy-only seat that hands implementation to someone else. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users.

How the process works

Application 7 short questions sent to you by email evidence review live working session (diagnose a site propose the AEO plan measurement plan) paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

Apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

data.description_html:
Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.


The Opportunity

Top Dog Law is one of the fastest-growing personal injury law firms in the country. Our decision science team turns data into decisions that move the business, not reports that sit in a folder. We're seeking a Senior Analyst to partner with our Client Marketing team and help us better understand, communicate with, and retain our clients.

The ideal candidate is a senior-level data analyst who is as comfortable writing complex SQL as they are explaining what the numbers mean to a marketing stakeholder. You will own the measurement behind how clients engage with Top Dog Law and use it to recommend what to change, what to scale, and what to stop.


What You Will Own

Client Marketing Analytics

  • Track and interpret client performance to understand adoption, engagement, and opportunities to improve the client experience
  • Report on and analyze metrics that drive client retention and engagement across the case lifecycle, including early indicators of disengagement and risk
  • Evaluate email and SMS performance to sharpen how, when, and what we communicate to clients
  • Measure and refine review generation strategies to grow the volume and quality of client reviews
  • Design and evaluate tests, and translate findings into clear recommendations for Client Marketing

Reporting & Decision Support

  • Write and maintain SQL that powers client marketing reporting and analysis
  • Build and maintain dashboards that surface actionable insights for Client Marketing
  • Prepare regular performance updates covering goals, results, and forward-looking recommendations
  • Gather and monitor NPS data
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to build workflows and accelerate analysis
  • Partner with data engineering and the broader decision science team to improve data quality and trust in the numbers

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data analyst role, with a track record of influencing business decisions
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, and window functions
  • Experience with web, email, SMS analytics and NPS
  • Experience analyzing CRM data (Salesforce)
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude to accelerate analysis and improve your work
  • Strong fundamentals in experimentation and statistics, including A/B testing and segmentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear story for non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven problem-solver who proactively identifies issues, diagnoses root causes, and acts without waiting to be directed

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with Braze or a comparable customer engagement platform
  • Experience in client retention, customer lifecycle, or customer experience analytics
  • Experience with review generation or online reputation management
  • Experience in legal, insurance, or other service-based industries
  • Familiarity with modern BI and dashboarding tools

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.


What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $105,000 - $129,000, commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.


DISCLAIMER: Each TopDog Law affiliated entity may use may use artificial intelligence (AI) and automated decision-making tools to assist in screening and evaluating candidates for employment positions, including whether to advance a candidate in the application process. These tools assess job-related qualifications and characteristics—such as work experience, education, and skills relevant to the position as described in the job posting—based on information you provide in your application materials (e.g., resume, application responses, and other submitted materials, if any).

All adverse decisions affecting your candidacy are reviewed by a human member of our Talent Acquisition team before being finalized. AI does not make the final decision on your candidacy.

If you have questions about this notice, wish to request additional information about how AI was used in a decision affecting you, wish to request correction of inaccurate data, or need a reasonable accommodation that is required by law regarding TopDog Law's use of these tools, please contact: Talent Acquisition Department | [recruitment@topdoglaw.com
#LI-Remote

data.description_html:
Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.
Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.
Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.


We need an Affiliates Marketing Manager to help grow and manage Pattern's affiliate programs across major online marketplaces like Amazon and Walmart — building affiliate networks, running campaigns, and keeping brand partners informed on performance. It's a brand-facing role where you'll get to work with a wide range of well-known brands across industries like CPG, beauty, and wellness, so the work never gets stale even though the core process stays consistent. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule based in Lehi.

What is a day in the life of an Affiliate Marketing Manager?

  • Research and reach out to potential affiliates and creators across marketplace platforms (Amazon, Walmart, and others)

  • Build, launch, and manage affiliate campaigns, including setting and monitoring budgets

  • Serve as a brand-facing point of contact, providing regular reporting, strategy, and program updates to partners

  • Monitor overall affiliate program health and budgets across marketplace retailers and proactively flag issues

  • Build and grow affiliate networks, crafting messaging and strategies to engage affiliates

  • Use affiliate platforms such as Levanta and Impact (or similar tools) to manage campaigns across retailers

What will I need to thrive in this role?

  • 2-5+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally in affiliate marketing, marketplace management, or an agency setting

  • Hands-on experience with marketplace affiliate programs such as Amazon or Walmart

  • A clear understanding of how affiliate programs function: building affiliate networks, creating campaigns, and managing budgets

  • Strong executive and business presence, with the polish and terminology to represent Pattern directly to brand partners face-to-face

  • Proven ability to multitask and manage a high volume of brand accounts at once (agency experience managing 40+ accounts is a plus)

  • Familiarity with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact is a bonus, though not required — these are learnable on the job

  • Background in CPG, pharmaceuticals, vitamins/minerals/supplements, or beauty is a plus (not required)

  • Background in Amazon advertising a plus

What does high performance look like?

  • You build strong, trusted relationships with your brand partners and are seen as a reliable point of contact

  • You independently manage a large, varied portfolio of brands and proactively monitor and resolve program health issues

  • Some examples might include these:

  • You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

  • Ability to work cross functionally between both internal and external teams

  • You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given

  • You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is the team like?

You will work alongside other members of the Marketplaces team, and be managed by our Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

Sounds great! What’s the company culture?

We are looking for individuals who are:

  • Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.

  • Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.

  • Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.

  • Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

  • Initial phone screen with Pattern's talent acquisition team

  • Screening interview focused on general marketplace understanding and business acumen

  • Topgrading interview with the hiring manager

  • Final round and professional

  • Reference Checks

  • Executive approval

  • Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

  • Speak specifically to your experience with marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Walmart, etc.) — not just social/creator platforms

  • Share data or examples of managing a high volume of brand or client accounts at once

  • Highlight your business acumen and comfort presenting directly to brand partners/clients

  • Mention any experience with CPG, pharma, vitamins/supplements, or beauty brands, or with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact

Why should I work at Pattern?
Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid Holidays
  • Onsite Fitness Center
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Casual Dress Code
  • Competitive Pay
  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need an Affiliates Marketing Manager to help grow and manage Pattern's affiliate programs across major online marketplaces like Amazon and Walmart — building affiliate networks, running campaigns, and keeping brand partners informed on performance. It's a brand-facing role where you'll get to work with a wide range of well-known brands across industries like CPG, beauty, and wellness, so the work never gets stale even though the core process stays consistent. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule based in Lehi.

What is a day in the life of an Affiliate Marketing Manager?

Research and reach out to potential affiliates and creators across marketplace platforms (Amazon, Walmart, and others)

Build, launch, and manage affiliate campaigns, including setting and monitoring budgets

Serve as a brand-facing point of contact, providing regular reporting, strategy, and program updates to partners

Monitor overall affiliate program health and budgets across marketplace retailers and proactively flag issues

Build and grow affiliate networks, crafting messaging and strategies to engage affiliates

Use affiliate platforms such as Levanta and Impact (or similar tools) to manage campaigns across retailers

What will I need to thrive in this role?

2-5+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally in affiliate marketing, marketplace management, or an agency setting

Hands-on experience with marketplace affiliate programs such as Amazon or Walmart

A clear understanding of how affiliate programs function: building affiliate networks, creating campaigns, and managing budgets

Strong executive and business presence, with the polish and terminology to represent Pattern directly to brand partners face-to-face

Proven ability to multitask and manage a high volume of brand accounts at once (agency experience managing 40+ accounts is a plus)

Familiarity with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact is a bonus, though not required — these are learnable on the job

Background in CPG, pharmaceuticals, vitamins/minerals/supplements, or beauty is a plus (not required)

Background in Amazon advertising a plus

What does high performance look like?

You build strong, trusted relationships with your brand partners and are seen as a reliable point of contact

You independently manage a large, varied portfolio of brands and proactively monitor and resolve program health issues

Some examples might include these:

You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

Ability to work cross functionally between both internal and external teams

You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given

You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is the team like?

You will work alongside other members of the Marketplaces team, and be managed by our Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

Sounds great! What’s the company culture?

We are looking for individuals who are:

Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.

Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.

Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.

Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

Initial phone screen with Pattern's talent acquisition team

Screening interview focused on general marketplace understanding and business acumen

Topgrading interview with the hiring manager

Final round and professional

Reference Checks

Executive approval

Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

Speak specifically to your experience with marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Walmart, etc.) — not just social/creator platforms

Share data or examples of managing a high volume of brand or client accounts at once

Highlight your business acumen and comfort presenting directly to brand partners/clients

Mention any experience with CPG, pharma, vitamins/supplements, or beauty brands, or with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

data.description_html:
Reports to: Eric Siu, CEO
Type: Full-time, hands-on player-coach. Client-facing. Not a people-manager seat.
Clients: an assigned book of Single Grain paid media accounts (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic)
Location: Full-time, remote (United States or Latin America; at least 4 hours of US overlap; professional English)
Comp: $100,000–$150,000 USD / year, depending on location

One-liner

Own paid growth for a book of Single Grain clients as their performance strategist, and build the AI workflows that take build-outs, reporting, and QA off your plate.

About the role

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat runs paid search, paid social, and programmatic for an assigned set of client accounts. You still get your hands in the accounts; your agents do most of the production. Clients treat you as their growth strategist: you tell them what to test next, and you tie spend to pipeline and revenue, not ROAS screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. The platforms already run on automation (Performance Max, Meta Advantage+, smart bidding); you know when to trust it and when to override it. On top of that you build your own agents for build-outs, pacing, reporting, creative iteration, and QA, and you check their output before it touches client spend.

What you will own

  • Diagnose each client's paid program; set baselines and targets (CAC, ROAS, CPL, qualified pipeline, revenue) and own the plan.

  • Run and optimize accounts across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic within approved budgets.

  • Ship test cycles fast: from idea to first readout in under five working days.

  • Run an account health + QA agent on every account: weekly pacing, anomaly flags (spend spikes, broken tracking, disapprovals), and next-test recommendations.

  • Run AI creative iteration: generate ad and landing-page variants, test them, and keep a human brand and claims check before anything goes live.

  • Lead client strategy calls and bring proactive recommendations every month.

  • Report monthly in terms a GM would use: spend tied to pipeline and revenue, with baselines.

  • Write runbooks so the work does not depend on you being at the keyboard.

What success looks like

  • By day 30: client diagnoses done; baselines and targets agreed; your account health + QA agent is live on your accounts and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.

  • By day 60: test cycles running on every account; AI creative iteration live on at least one account; monthly reporting ties spend to pipeline or revenue.

  • By day 90: launch-to-learn under five working days; at least one account showing measurable CAC, ROAS, or pipeline improvement vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = tests still launched without a hypothesis, baseline, or readout.

  • By 6–12 months: client programs hit their agreed targets; workflows do 70%+ of paid production; you have designed yourself out of the daily build queue.

Evidence we want to see

  • About 5+ years in digital paid media, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, and still running accounts yourself, with spend scale.

  • One paid result with the metric, baseline, period, and how you attributed it.

  • One AI workflow or agent you built that removed real paid production work, and what it changed.

  • AI fluency you can show: the workflow's inputs, outputs, and controls, and how you check agent or platform-automation output before it touches spend.

  • Client-facing strategy: examples where you set the plan, not just executed tickets.

  • Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).

  • Ideal: growth/performance agency, B2B SaaS lead gen, or multi-client experience.

What this role is not

Not a media buyer or ticket-taker. Not vendor management only. Not TV, OOH, or print planning. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users. Not a fit if freelancing, consulting, or your own agency is your main work today.

How the process works

Application 7 short questions sent to you by email evidence review live working session (diagnose an account propose tests measurement plan) paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

Apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.
